title: 墨韵心境
text:
昨夜窗前明月高悬，清辉洒在案头几卷残书之上。我忽然想起文人画之精髓，不在于形似，而在于神韵。古之名士挥毫泼墨，非为写实，实为寄情。其笔触纵横间，尽显胸中丘壑。观其兰竹，不求叶之纤细，但求气节之高标。画中之空白，并非虚无，而是留给观者想象之余地。此谓之气韵生动，使静止之纸上生出灵动之气。
文人画之魂，在于一种超脱尘世的孤傲。他们将内心之寂寥，化作淡墨之氤氲。不事雕琢，不尚繁琐，唯求自然天成。每一道线条的转折，皆是心境之起伏。墨色浓淡之间，蕴含着人生之酸甜苦辣。这种艺术形式，是文人与自我对话的途径。在喧嚣世界中，寻找一份精神的栖息之所。
笔墨之妙，在于能将无形之意转化为有形之象。所谓意在笔先，即是心中已有丘壑，手下随之而动。其追求之境界，是物我两忘，天人合一。这种审美情趣，深深植根于东方哲学之中。它不追求视觉之冲击，而倾向于心境之共鸣。
当我们凝视一幅古画，仿佛能听见千年前的松涛之声。那是文人志向的投射，也是灵魂的独白。在简练的勾勒中，隐藏着对宇宙万物之深刻洞察。这种精神之美，跨越时空，依旧能触动现代人之心弦。它教会我们如何在纷扰中保持一份淡然。于方寸之间，见乾坤之大。

questions.prompt: According to the text, wherein does the essence of literati painting lie?
options: In photographic likeness to its subject
In its spirit and charm rather than literal resemblance
In its market value
In the size of the canvas

questions.prompt: Why did ancient masters paint, according to the text?
options: To achieve realistic portrayal
To express and convey their inner feelings
To sell their work for profit
To document historical events

questions.prompt: What does the "blank space" in a literati painting represent, according to the text?
options: An unfinished work
Room left for the viewer's imagination, not emptiness
A mistake made by the painter
A lack of skill

questions.prompt: What does the concept "the intention precedes the brush" mean, according to the text's explanation?
options: The brush moves before any thought occurs
The idea already exists in the mind before the brush moves
Painting requires no planning at all
The brush chooses its own path

questions.prompt: According to the text, what realm does literati painting ultimately pursue?
options: Commercial success
A state of forgetting both self and object, a unity of heaven and humanity
Technical perfection alone
Public recognition

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
